lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: The plan is to try the space on Thursday afternoon. I'm meeting the manager at one thirty for a short orientation, so that part is confirmed.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: And you're working there for the rest of the day?

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: Probably, but nothing's set in stone after two. I may have a client call at three, and the small phone room might already be booked.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: So you're saying that the orientation is fixed, but the full afternoon depends on the phone room.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: Right. If it isn't available, I'm going to take the call from home and return to the studio another day.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: The manager is checking the room schedule tomorrow morning. I'll know more by noon.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: What about the day pass you mentioned yesterday?

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: The studio is giving me the trial day for free, so I'm not buying a pass yet. After Thursday, I might buy two individual passes before I consider a monthly desk.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Let me make sure I've got this right. You're meeting the manager at one thirty. You're going to test the desk and internet. You may stay all afternoon, but that depends on the phone room. Did I miss anything?

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: The access code. They're sending it Thursday morning, and I'll call the front desk if it doesn't arrive by eleven.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Good. Are you going to tell your client that the location may change?

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: Yes. I'll send a short update now: “Our three o'clock call is confirmed. I may join from a shared studio, but the time and link won't change.”

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Clear and useful. You don't need to describe every possibility.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: Exactly. The plan is flexible, not mysterious. Tomorrow I'll confirm the room; on Thursday I'll test the space; after that I'll decide whether another visit is useful.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: That sounds more reliable than pretending the whole week is fixed.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: I used to think a good plan had no question marks. Now I think a good plan shows where the question marks are.
